title: Suggest an edit (replaces public edit controls)
description:
As a reader, I want to suggest a correction to a wiki page, so that errors reach the desk without public editing.

Uses the existing public form endpoint (stores a private message for the desk). Shows "Updated DATE" and a link to the entity's graph JSON.

```gherkin
Feature: Suggest an edit
  Scenario: Submit a suggestion
    When a reader submits a suggestion on a page
    Then the desk receives a message that names the page
    And nothing changes on the public page
```

Live checked: /wiki/ 200 (29 pages), /wiki/task-typed-decisions/ and /wiki/platform-hugging-face/ 200 with stamp, trend, neighbourhood, related, suggest form; sitemap 282 wiki urls plus listing; llms.txt lists them; every trending-strip link on / returns 200. OPEN BUG: the suggest-an-edit POST to the site's own public form endpoint returns 500 store-failed because amplify/data/schema.ts schemaExcludingGroups skips allow.resource(publicForms).to(['mutate']) when plugins are enabled (Shipped enables the newsletter plugin), so the function cannot create Message rows.
